$comment: The class packages Apache Tomcat 11 always loads from its own lib/ before the web
application (WebappClassLoaderBase.filter in Tomcat 11.0.x). A copy in the WAR is never
used while the container has the class, so it can only mislead tools and tests that run
outside Tomcat (issue #5416: EL 5.0.1 shipped beside Tomcat 11's EL 6.0).
applicationPackages are the exceptions the filter itself makes. containerServices are
service files whose presence in the WAR would install a competing implementation of a
container API, because the API looks it up through the web application's class loader:
jakarta.el.ExpressionFactory.newInstance(), and the WebSocket ContainerProvider and default
ServerEndpointConfig.Configurator. requiredClasses must ship, because Tomcat provides
no JSTL. Prefixes are zip entry paths ('/'-separated, trailing '/').
Read by scripts/check-war-container-apis.py and ContainerApiPackagingUnitTest; see
